title: CredentialCompromisedEvent
description: Emitted when a specific credential is identified as compromised and revoked (ADR-0016 §12-13 -- credential lifecycle is independent of Canonical Identity state; revoking one credential SHOULD invalidate only that credential unless broader compromise is suspected. ADR-0015 §77-80/§187 'Credential Compromise Flow': identify the affected credential, then revoke it). credential_type enumerates ADR-0015 §5's supported human authenticator categories. This is the event envelope's `data` payload — see asyncapi.yaml for how it composes with contracts/events/v1/envelope.schema.json.

credential_id.description: Opaque IAM-assigned identifier for the specific credential (not the credential value itself).

actor.description: Who performed the action (system or human ID).
